comments.body:
A PR for this is here: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/882

As mentioned in the github PR comment, I would like feedback on what to do with the last vestige of modeshape in the kernel-api.

This PR impacts the following projects as well:

  • fcrepo-module-auth-rbacl
  • fcrepo-module-auth-xacml
  • fcrepo-module-auth-webac
  • fcrepo4-client
  • fcrepo4-oaiprovider
  • fcrepo4-swordserver

Additional PRs:

fcrepo-module-auth-rbacl: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-module-auth-rbacl/pull/26
fcrepo-module-auth-xacml: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-module-auth-xacml/pull/46
fcrepo-module-auth-webac: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-module-auth-webac/pull/50
fcrepo4-client: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-client/pull/35
fcrepo4-oaiprovider: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/pull/28
fcrepo4-swordserver: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-swordserver/pull/14
